scientific_limitations: The equilibrium classification concerns balanced positive target rates in a fixed-population deterministic matching-feedback model. Normal spectral and trajectory-selection statements require common-rate linear adjustment, and global explicit selection further requires within-side homogeneous initial data. Equivalent prior formulations remain a historical-priority risk.
